topics.title: The Computer System
topics.content: A computer system is a group of hardware and software components that work together. The physical devices let us enter data, process it, display results and store information.

Identify the important terms and tools connected with this topic.

topics.title: How Does a Computer Work?
topics.content: A computer follows a working cycle: it receives data as input, processes the data according to instructions, and provides information as output. It can also store data for later use.

topics.title: Types of Computers
topics.content: Computers are available in different forms for different needs. Desktop computers are commonly used at desks, laptops are portable, and smaller devices are designed for mobile use or specialised tasks.

topics.content: Hardware means the physical parts of a computer that we can see and touch. Examples include the monitor, keyboard, mouse, CPU cabinet, printer and storage devices.
